name: LG4M

args.name: alpha
args.description: The shape parameter for the Gamma distribution

description: A mixture of four empirical amino-acid substitution models fitted to sites with different evolutionary rates. The four components have equal weights and are paired, in order, with increasing rates from four equal-probability gamma categories. This implementation represents each category by its median rate.

citation.title: Modeling Protein Evolution with Several Amino Acid Replacement Matrices Depending on Site Rates
